liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Let It Grow** (1 review): Bobby executed the transition from Lazy Lightnin' jam into Let It Grow best here [21]

## The recordings

- **gd1986-04-13.sbd.walker-scotton.miller.81647.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 19 songs; 143 min; rated 2.83/5 by 12 [1]
- **gd1986-04-13.Senn421.Darby.119476.Flac1644**: audience recording; 19 songs; 141 min; rated 3/5 by 1 [2]
- **gd1986-04-13.148867.fob.neumann.km84i.hecht.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 19 songs; 142 min [7]
- **gd1986-04-13.Senn421.Darby.119475.Flac2448**: audience recording; 19 songs; 141 min; rated 3/5 by 1 [3]

## Around the show

- Jerry left mid-Terrapin, prompting Brent to start Don't Need Love before drums [11]
- Rumors circulated that Jerry had heart problems and needed rest after the show [11]
- Box of Rain was a first for the west coast in years [11]
- Bobby reacted with a double take as Jerry abruptly left the stage [12]
- Jerry walked off mid-song, skipping the usual spiral light and crickets sections [13]
- Jerry abruptly walked off mid-song, skipping the usual spiral light and crickets sections [17]
- Jerry left after Lady With A Fan, possibly to take a break or adjust [19]
- Jerry likely needed to use the facilities or sit down due to diabetes [20]
- The Sunday show was much better than the previous day's performance [15]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1986-04-13.sbd.walker-scotton.miller.81647.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master -> Cassette -> Cassette D [1]. Also: Cassettes provided by Paul Scotton and Joani Walker; possibly one less generation [1]
- **gd1986-04-13.Senn421.Darby.119476.Flac1644**: taped by Mike Darby; transferred by Keo; source: Master Audience Recorded By Mr. Darby; SennheiserMD421's (PAS/Loge Row 6 Row FF Seat 617/6 Feet High)> Sony TC D5M,Tapes Maxell MX; Transfer Information:Tascam… [2]
- **gd1986-04-13.148867.fob.neumann.km84i.hecht.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Chris Hecht; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: Chris Hecht's Master (FOB) Audience Cassettes; Neumann KM84i mics > Sony D5M [7]
- **gd1986-04-13.Senn421.Darby.119475.Flac2448**: taped by Mike Darby; transferred by Keo; source: Master Audience Recorded By Mr. Darby; SennheiserMD421's (PAS/Loge Row 6 Row FF Seat 617/6 Feet High)> Sony TC D5M,Tapes Maxell MX; Transfer Information:Tascam… [3]
